requirements.requirement: The product is in HS heading 19.01.
requirements.evidence: The declared HS code is 1901.20. The product description fits heading 19.01: “Malted bread mix (wheat flour with dried malt extract and baking powder), for home baking, 1 kg bags”.

requirements.requirement: Imported ingredients of heading 19.01 are at most 15% of the ex-works price.
requirements.evidence: Bakery premix preparation may be an imported ingredient of heading 19.01. The value, HS code or origin is missing or contradictory. The share cannot be calculated yet.

requirements.requirement: The work done in Ghana includes eligible manufacturing processes under AfCFTA guidelines, not only mixing, grinding or packing.
requirements.evidence: These manufacturing processes are eligible under AfCFTA guidelines: mashing of malt with hot water in a mash tun (enzymatic conversion) and drum drying of the malt extract with part of the flour.

requirements.requirement: No ingredient comes from food aid (donated or non-commercial supplies).
requirements.evidence: The production notes state that no ingredient comes from food aid.

requirements.requirement: There is proof of origin for local and AfCFTA ingredients.
requirements.evidence: Supplier declarations are on file for 2 of 2 ingredients from Ghana or other AfCFTA countries.
